show: Romance of the Three Kingdoms Podcast

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts; nach 880 Tagen in der Cloud transkribiert, statt weiter auf den Rechner zu warten - das Modell schaetzt Zeitangaben, statt sie zu messen

einzeiler: Celebrating ten years of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms podcast.
kurzfassung: The host marks the tenth anniversary of publishing the first episode of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms podcast. They reflect on the evolution of podcasting and the enduring value of the connection between podcaster and audience. Finally, they express deep gratitude to listeners for their support, financial contributions, and encouraging messages over the decade.
stichpunkte: Marking ten years since the launch of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms podcast
Expressing gratitude to listeners for their support and financial contributions
Reflecting on major changes in the podcasting medium over the past decade
Highlighting the core appeal of the medium as the relationship between podcaster and audience
Recalling the early days of do-it-yourself podcasting and sharing passions with others
Reaffirming the show's status as a passion project driven by love for the topic
Appreciating listener emails about discovering or reconnecting with classic Chinese tales
